notes.title: Update - Added Walkabout Locomotion
notes.content:
2016-08-27 changelog:
-Walkabout locomotion is now available as an option
-teleport is now always available via the menu button on the movement controller
-players can no longer walk through walls
-gems no longer fall through pillar bases
-labels on the controllers have been improved
-a few new things to find in the Labyrinth

notes.title: Update - Gem Shrines
notes.content:
2016-08-14 changelog
-added gem shrines, which give you bonus gems in your choice of color or shape
-arrow disc now stays under you as you walk around your space
-gems now tumble a bit when you pull them
-changed the ‘collect’ label on the flashlight controller to say ‘pull gems’ instead.
